race.comment: JUSTIBELLA (10) led for home but tired late and finished a distant third last start over 1700m at Warrnambool. That followed a six-week let-up so she strips fitter this time. Better placed back to 1400m and should give backers a great sight. FORT OF DREAMS (5) was in front turning for home but found a couple better in the closing stages of a Sale maiden over this distance last start. Fitter for two runs back from a spell. Can roll along in front and give them something to catch. COSMIC COMMAND (7) ran a nice race over 1200m here first-up then found the metro company a bit rich last time. Lightly raced mare who can bounce back in this more suitable assignment. FILIGREE SHADOW (8) has raced just three times and been about the money on each occasion. Ran a nice race on the synthetic here two back. Should give a good account again. DUPEROUZEL (4) is a chance if he finds the form that saw him lead then hold on for second over this course and distance two runs back.
